[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pomodoro-timer"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "A modern, native macOS Pomodoro timer with a distraction-focused blue/green design."
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "L3monKenji" }]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "PySide6>=6.6",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.0",
]
package = [
    "pyinstaller>=6.11",
]

[project.scripts]
pomodoro = "pomodoro.cli:main"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/l3montree-dev/pomodoro"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
---FILES---
./packaging/pomodoro_app.py
./packaging/make_icon.py
./src/pomodoro/__init__.py
./src/pomodoro/__main__.py
./src/pomodoro/cli.py
./src/pomodoro/audio/__init__.py
./src/pomodoro/audio/notifications.py
./src/pomodoro/audio/player.py
./src/pomodoro/persistence/__init__.py
./src/pomodoro/persistence/settings.py
./src/pomodoro/persistence/paths.py
./src/pomodoro/persistence/history.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/widgets.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/stats_view.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/__init__.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/theme.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/main_window.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/confetti.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/app.py
./src/pomodoro/gui/timer_view.py
./src/pomodoro/core/timer.py
./src/pomodoro/core/__init__.py
./tests/test_timer.py
./tests/__init__.py
./tests/test_paths.py

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null && echo "---FILES---" && find . -path ./.venv -prune -o -name "*.py" -print | head -50
